text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Morning. On my way to work,
I spotted Manhattan Cafe
training.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah... haah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing sweat pouring like a waterfall made me catch my breath.
Just how long has she
been running here?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, last night too—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah... I can still, still run...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Faster... so I can catch up...
I must run...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though she was running until so late at night,
to think she's already doing morning training—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...It's normal... It's just... what I always do.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The night is quiet... and
the other side... is easier to see...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I can concentrate...
and run... with my "friend"...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
choice_data_list: I thought you were alone last night...
I thought you were the only one there last night...

text_block_list.name: Bright-Haired Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, excuse me!
Cafe-san, do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...No... This is the first time... we've met...

text_block_list.name: Bright-Haired Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. Nice to meet you!
Actually, all this time, I—

text_block_list.name: Bright-Haired Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
I've always thought you were amazing,
Cafe-san, training all by yourself
in silence like that!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Amazing...?
...I was just... running, though...

text_block_list.name: Bright-Haired Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
E-Even so! That's why, um... if it's okay,
would you run with me sometime, I was wondering...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: With me... you mean...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
............
...I don't... particularly mind, but...

text_block_list.name: Bright-Haired Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ah, really?!
Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Bright-Haired Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
I thought... I could keep up...
Before I knew it, you were so far ahead...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...From your breathing... I could tell
when you'd make your move...
I just... shook you off a little.

text_block_list.name: Bright-Haired Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ahaha... Incredible.
It's true, I panicked and
ended up losing my pace.

text_block_list.name: Bright-Haired Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
You were truly amazing. Once you passed me,
I felt like I could never reclaim the lead again... That's how it felt.

text_block_list.name: Bright-Haired Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
You were looking straight ahead,
as if completely unconcerned about what was behind you...
Don't you ever worry about what's behind you?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Even if I pass you... up ahead...
there's still the back of my "friend"... so...

text_block_list.name: Bright-Haired Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
Still, somehow... that's frustrating.

text_block_list.name: Bright-Haired Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
No, it's nothing!
Thank you so much for today!
Please run with me again sometime. Well then!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
............
What a strange... horse girl...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Is there anything... to be gained...
by running... with me...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...When I am just... chasing after...
my "friend"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having said that, Manhattan Cafe stared out at the ostensibly empty track,
and began running once more.
